Seven fresh candidate compilations bind the exact 35ee compiler and retain the original 10 CPU second / 20 wall second / 256 MiB compile limits and complete child receipts. The exact two-byte-region test inverse leaves all original fixtures, oracle calls, comparisons, error requirements and group resource checks unchanged. The CI selects all 13 original groups: semantic, errors, interfaces, input, identity, functions-1024, large-bytes, large-nodes, large-valid, impact-semantic, graph-1024, graph-dense, graph-long-report. It checks the original aggregate 329 cases, complete output equality, actual source custody and per-group terminal results; failures are retained rather than skipped.

The builder retains parent RLIMIT_CPU=90, address space 1 GiB, core=0, aggregate self plus reaped-child CPU checks and elapsed wall checks. Its final path freezes each observed source/image with complete bytes and mode, verifies complete zlib CAS payloads, checks source/image identity again and records aggregate CPU/wall. The CI wraps the complete subprocess tree with the 90 CPU / 180 wall limits and checks its final result as well. The existing common.finish storage phase is explicitly described as lacking an independent 90 CPU / 180 wall gate; it is not credited as a bounded subject run.

limitations: This is a static review of the three exact files and the complete two-substitution original-test proof; it is not execution qualification, performance measurement, or an independent rerun of the 63-role baseline.
The prior seven-source mechanical review and this integration review cover different scopes; neither implies successful future Core/B3/native gates.
The builder's failure evidence writes can themselves fail; this review does not certify recovery from arbitrary storage or evidence-writing failures.
The static assertions must execute successfully with the actual immutable artifact and exact dependency bytes before any semantic claim is made.
No complete ordinary impact closure, installed activation, whole native stack, arbitrary foreign-object authentication, or changed resource budget is asserted.
